title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 73

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 73
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 73
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th November, 1979]
No. 73
In Martial Law Order No. 5, in
paragraph 1, in sub-paragraph (e), after the full-stop at the end, the words
and full-stop "The provisions of the Execu tion of Punishment of Whipping
Ordinance, 1979 (IX of 1979), shall not apply to the execution of punishment of
whipping awarded by Military Courts and the same shall be executed in the
manner in which the punishment used to be executed before the commencement of
the said Ordinance", shall be inserted and shall be deemed to have been so
inserted on the ninth day of February, 1979.
